title: Cargo audit + Cargo.lock 完整性 CI
description:
Rust 侧供应链: 每 PR 跑 `cargo audit --deny warnings` + `cargo tree --duplicates` 检测.
Cargo.lock 必须 commit (workspace 根); PR 若改依赖但没更新 lock → FAIL.

Cindy Node 侧对应 `pnpm.overrides` (CVE 治理) — Rust 用 [patch.crates-io] + cargo audit 双闸.

新 workflow: .github/workflows/cargo-audit.yml (schedule: weekly + on cargo file change).
acceptance: cargo-audit.yml 存在, 触发 pull_request + schedule(weekly)
cargo audit --deny warnings 在 CI 中执行, warnings 阻塞 merge
PR 若改 rust/**/Cargo.toml 但 Cargo.lock 未同步 → CI FAIL
文档: docs/reference/supply-chain-cargo.md 说明如何应对 CVE 提示

verification.cargo_audit_local_run: skipped — cargo-audit not installed locally; CI installs via `cargo install cargo-audit --locked`
